releases.title: Signed in, for real

highlights.title: Vinted sign-in works
highlights.text: After you sign in, Vintly sees it straight away and loads Vinted's fields.

highlights.title: Prepare with AI works
highlights.text: Cleaning photos and filling the listing no longer stop with a JavaScript error.

highlights.title: Clearer messages
highlights.text: If Vinted can't be reached, Vintly says why instead of just “not signed in”.

changes: Fixed: every request to Vinted and every photo cleanup failed on iPhone with “JavaScript execution returned a result of an unsupported type”
Fixed: Vintly said “Not signed in” after a successful sign-in; the check now runs in the page you signed in with
The sign-in and Check messages say what went wrong when the check itself fails

releases.title: Snap it, list it

highlights.title: Photos to listings
highlights.text: Take a few photos of each thing; ✦ AI sorts them and writes every listing.

highlights.title: Clean backgrounds
highlights.text: The background goes and your item keeps its own pixels, on white.

highlights.title: Posted in one tap
highlights.text: Vinted's own fields are filled in; check them, then post or save a draft.

changes: Take photos or choose them (or share them to Vintly from Photos); several items at once
✦ AI sorts a batch of photos into items; move any photo to another item by hand
✦ Photo cleanup with OpenAI's image model: keep the item's own pixels (cut along a drawn mask) or an AI studio photo
✦ Listings from photos with Claude or OpenAI: title and description in two languages (Lithuanian and English by default), with a little humour
Vinted's categories, brands, sizes, conditions, colours, parcel sizes and price suggestions fill the form
A fair price under what similar used items sell for (Settings › Pricing)
Review every field, then post on Vinted or save a Vinted draft; sign in to Vinted inside Vintly
Works without AI: fill in the listing yourself, Vintly still does the Vinted part
Home Screen and Lock Screen widget, launch screen, Settings, in-app updates, opt-in anonymous usage counts (app-blueprints)
